title: Basis expanded field family
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and nonzero $\ell$, and an element $r$ of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, define a family indexed by $q\in\mathrm{Fin}(n\ell)$ as follows. Write the index corresponding to $q$ as $(i,j)\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$; its family value is the $j$th binary extension basis vector multiplied by $r^{i+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ belongs to the binary extension field of degree $\ell$
caveat: The defining convention for `binaryExtensionBasisVector` is not supplied, so the basis vector cannot be described more explicitly.
